meta.parties: Ceylon State Mortgage Bank v. Fernando

rules.statement: A Labour Tribunal has jurisdiction to hear an employee's claim for an enhanced gratuity even if the amount was initially paid based on a procedural rule, and the State Mortgage Bank Ordinance does not explicitly prohibit such claims.
rules.supporting_quote: "I cannot imagine that a procedural rule (PI) passed in 1944 even before we gained independence, has the effect of ousting the jurisdiction of Labour Tribunals constituted by the legislature long after that in order to settle, precisely this type of dispute between employer and employee."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 94 (1) (c) of the State Mortgage Bank Ordinance (Cap. 398)
